arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Bishop stated the Clean Water Act defines seven narrow appellate categories.
Mr. Murphy argued Congress examined specific delegations of authority in statutes.
Ms. Kovner explained broad water definitions impose broader limitations on conduct.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on which federal court reviews challenges to the definition of waters of the United States. Manufacturers claim district courts hold this authority. The government asserts courts of appeals possess exclusive jurisdiction.
